$comment: Requests to the web_schedule_editor API and the answers they get. The format is the thermostat editor's (doc/TESTING.md), with an environment of its own and a case's `clock`, `held` and `climate_hub`.

cases.name: A name that is no route is 404
A GET to a route that writes is 405 naming POST
A POST to a route that reads is 405 naming GET
An OPTIONS is 405 too
Ping answers ok
Schema lists the limits, the days, the colours and the values each target takes
An empty device lists nothing, with its clock
List shows a running thermostat schedule, the point in force and the next
A row names every relay and thermostat the modes name, each once, in the order they name them
Before today's first point, yesterday's last is in force
Early on Monday, Sunday's last point is in force
Late on Sunday, the next point is Monday's first
On the minute of a point, that point is in force and the next is the one after
A week with one point has it in force all week, and next a week on
Without a valid clock a schedule waits and has no point in force
A disabled schedule says so and still shows its points
A relay the device does not have is an issue of the actions on it, named by its id

issues.text: Thermostat "attic" is not on this device

cases.name: A preset the thermostat does not have is an issue of the action that names it
The issues are every action the device would skip, mode by mode, the waiting ones too
